practice_units.title: Role of an MLA
practice_units.problem: Describe how an MLA (Member of Legislative Assembly) represents their constituency.
guidance: Note that MLAs are elected by the people of that area.
Identify their role in debating issues and passing laws in the Vidhan Sabha.
practice_units.solution: An MLA listens to the problems of people in their constituency, raises these issues in the Legislative Assembly, and participates in making laws for the state.
